title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-029
doc_notes: This document contains personnel statements and flight logs from the FAA regarding the Japan Airlines Flight 628 UFO sighting incident.

incidents.summary: Japan Airlines Flight 628 reported observing unusual pulsating lights and a large black object near their aircraft over Alaska.
incidents.explanation: The pilot later suggested the lights were village lights distorted by ice crystals; controllers noted weather clutter and temperature inversions.
incidents.location_name: North of Nenana and Fort Yukon, Alaska
incidents.quote: We see irregular pulsating lights just, there is a black chunk (just) in front (of us)
